body.name: \(\mathcal M_n(d;B,c)\)
body.construction: \[\mathcal M_n(d;B,c)=\left\{(G_n,Y_n):\ G_n\text{ is simple and undirected},\ Y_n\text{ satisfies arbitrary neighborhood interference on }G_n,\ D_n\le d,\ \frac1n\sum_i|a_{n,i}|^4\le B,\ \frac1n\sum_i|b_{n,i}|^4\le B,\ \sigma_n^2\ge\frac{c\lambda_n}{n}\right\}.\]
